rules.name: Single-Order Stock Locking
rules.statement: A specific stock quantity must be locked exclusively to a single Order Request until the Fulfillment Task is completed or the Order Request is cancelled.
rules.condition: When a Fulfillment Task is created for an Order Request
rules.if_violated: The system must prevent the creation of a second Fulfillment Task for the same stock unit and flag the inventory as corrupted
rules.rationale: Prevents overselling and ensures inventory accuracy in a high-velocity environment

parameters.name: lock_duration
parameters.description: Time window during which stock is reserved

rules.name: Mandatory Quality Verification
rules.statement: A Fulfillment Task may only transition to a 'Ready for Dispatch' status if a valid quality verification record exists for every item in the task.
rules.condition: When attempting to change Fulfillment Task status to 'Ready for Dispatch'
exceptions: Emergency override by Store Manager with audit trail
rules.if_violated: The system must block the status transition and display an error message requiring quality completion
rules.rationale: Ensures only verified, high-quality goods leave the store to maintain customer satisfaction

parameters.name: min_quality_items
parameters.description: Total number of items requiring verification

rules.name: Quality Failure Blocking
rules.statement: If a quality check fails for any item, the Fulfillment Task must be flagged as 'Requires Correction' and dispatch must be blocked.
rules.condition: When a quality verification record indicates a failure for any item
exceptions: Manual override by Store Manager with reason code
rules.if_violated: The system must prevent any further status changes or dispatch actions until the issue is resolved
rules.rationale: Prevents shipping defective or incorrect items to customers

parameters.name: failure_threshold
parameters.description: Number of failed items triggering the block

rules.name: Cancellation Inventory Release
rules.statement: Inventory locks must be released immediately upon confirmation of an Order Request cancellation, before the Fulfillment Task status changes to 'Ready for Dispatch'.
rules.condition: When an Order Request is confirmed as cancelled
exceptions: Pending refund processing delay exceeding 24 hours
rules.if_violated: The system must automatically revert the inventory to available status and notify the Store Partner
rules.rationale: Prevents stock from being held indefinitely by cancelled orders, optimizing inventory turnover

parameters.name: release_timeout
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed before automatic release
